The Tamil Nadu Sportsmen Development Allowance Scheme is a financial assistance initiative launched by the Tamil Nadu Government on 29 October 2026. The scheme aims to support sportspersons receiving training at government-run sports hostels and specialised sports centres. It provides monthly financial assistance to help athletes manage their personal expenses during training.
Under this scheme, eligible sportspersons will receive a monthly allowance of ₹500 or ₹1,000, depending on their training institution. Athletes training at regular Sports Development Authority of Tamil Nadu (SDAT) hostels and specialised sports centres will receive ₹500 per month. Those staying at Premier Sports Centre hostels will receive ₹1,000 per month. The allowance is one part of a broader push by the state, alongside its long-term Tamil Nadu Dream Olympics 2036 Scheme to build podium-ready athletes, to support sportspersons at the grassroots level.
The Tamil Nadu Government expects approximately 2,600 sportspersons to benefit from this initiative. It has allocated ₹1.77 crore annually for the implementation of the scheme. The financial assistance will help athletes meet their personal expenses and continue their sports training with better financial support.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay launched the Tamil Nadu Sports Persons Development Allowance Scheme during the closing ceremony of the Chief Minister's Trophy 2026 state-level sports competitions. The launch took place at Jawaharlal Nehru Indoor Stadium in Chennai on 29 October 2026.
Sportspersons receiving training at SDAT-run sports hostels, specialised sports centres, and Premier Sports Centre hostels are the intended beneficiaries. However, the government has not yet published detailed eligibility conditions, such as age limits, income criteria, or other selection requirements.
The government has not announced a separate online or offline application process for this allowance. Sportspersons already enrolled at eligible SDAT institutions can also contact their respective hostel authorities for more details. New athletes can apply for sports hostel admission through the existing SDAT selection process. They can visit the official SDAT website to check admission notifications and selection trial details.
Under the Tamil Nadu Sportsmen Development Allowance Scheme provides eligible beneficiaries will receive:
A monthly allowance of ₹500 for sportspersons training at SDAT-run sports hostels and specialised sports centres.
A higher monthly allowance of ₹1,000 for sportspersons training at hostels attached to premier sports centres.
The monthly allowance will help athletes manage their personal expenses during sports training.
Approximately 2,600 sportspersons will benefit from the scheme.
The Tamil Nadu Government has allocated ₹1.77 crore annually for the implementation of the scheme.
Sportspersons must meet the following conditions to receive financial assistance under the Tamil Nadu Sports Persons Development Allowance Scheme:
The applicant must be a sportsperson receiving training at a Sports Development Authority of Tamil Nadu (SDAT) hostel.
Sportspersons receiving training at SDAT specialised sports centres are also covered under the scheme.
Sportspersons staying at Primary Sports Centre hostels are eligible for the applicable monthly allowance.
The Tamil Nadu Government has not yet published detailed eligibility guidelines, including age limits, income criteria, or other selection conditions.
The government has not released a document checklist for the Sportsmen Development Allowance Scheme.

1. What is the Tamil Nadu Sports Persons Development Allowance Scheme?
The Tamil Nadu Sports Persons Development Allowance Scheme is a financial assistance initiative that provides monthly allowances to sportspersons training at government-run sports hostels and specialised sports centres.
2. When was the Tamil Nadu Sportsmen Development Allowance Scheme launched?
The Tamil Nadu Government launched the scheme on 29 October 2026. Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay launched it during the closing ceremony of the Chief Minister's Trophy 2026.
3. How much monthly allowance is provided under the scheme?
Eligible athletes at regular SDAT hostels and specialised sports centres receive ₹500 per month. Athletes staying at Primary Sports Centre hostels receive ₹1,000 per month.
4. Who can benefit from the Tamil Nadu Sports Persons Development Allowance Scheme?
Sportspersons receiving training at Sports Development Authority of Tamil Nadu (SDAT) hostels, specialised sports centres, and Primary Sports Centre hostels are the intended beneficiaries.
5. How many sportspersons will benefit from the scheme?
Approximately 2,600 sportspersons are expected to benefit from the Tamil Nadu Sports Persons Development Allowance Scheme.
6. Does every SDAT sports hostel student get ₹1,000 a month?
No. The ₹1,000 rate applies only to those training at hostels attached to premier sports centres. Students at other SDAT sports hostels and specialised sports centres get ₹500 a month.
